title: The Ledger of Ash Harbour
setting_summary: In the year 1847, the tide-locked port city of Ash Harbour is sealed off by a quarantine cordon after a fever outbreak, leaving its inhabitants rationed, watched, and ruled by a provost's tribunal. Every citizen is issued a numbered ledger page on which all movements and opinions must be recorded under penalty of exile to the salt flats. As the cordon tightens and grain stores dwindle, a clandestine circle begins to inscribe forbidden words in the margins of their ledgers, turning the instruments of surveillance into a quiet rebellion.
